data.assumption: “भारत में एक औसत ऑर्डर” से मेरा मतलब सभी non-test India showroom orders है, चाहे उनका status कुछ भी हो, और zero payment attempts वाले orders denominator में शामिल हैं।
data.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(pa.attempt_id) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS avg_payment_attempts_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
LEFT JOIN payment_attempts pa ON pa.order_id = o.order_id
  AND pa.is_test = false
WHERE o.is_test = false
  AND c.name = 'India'
